text:
Asking rents in Munich stand at a median of 23.23 €/m² (2026-06), up 3.0% on the year and +26.9% over five years. That ranks Munich #1 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 80% above the 2022 average contract rent of 12.89 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 1394 € a month in cold rent, 21.9% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 22 days and 34% are gone within a week; with 1.4% market-active vacancy and +3.3% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 24.44 €/m² (+5.2%), with an 80% range of 23.71 to 24.95 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
